requirement: The Design Load Cases (DLCs) for hurricane conditions must also take into account of the effects of the turbine’s operations during the hurricane’s passage.
scope: Offshore wind turbine support structures, specifically for hurricane conditions
source: Design Standards for Offshore Wind Farms (Contract M10PC00105)
related_domains: structural integrity; design loads; turbine operation; environmental conditions

requirement: The slamming load calculation follows the guidance given in IEC 61400-3 Annex D.
scope: Offshore wind farm structural analysis, specifically for breaking wave slamming loads.
related_domains: structural integrity; design standards; hydrodynamic loads

requirement: The uniform C_d and C_m coefficients of the equivalent monopile model for FAST load analysis must be calculated in a manner (as described in Section 2.2.2.4) such that under the same wave condition, the resultant shear force and overturning moment at the mudline of the equivalent monopile are comparable to those of the jacket support structure calculated using the actual C_d and C_m coefficients.
scope: Equivalent monopile models used in FAST load analysis for offshore wind turbine support structures.
source: Section 2.2.2.4 of Contract M10PC00105: Design Standards for Offshore Wind Farms Final Report
related_domains: structural analysis; numerical modeling; hydrodynamics; offshore wind engineering; design standards

requirement: The wave slamming load is calculated according to IEC 61400-3 (2009).
related_domains: structural integrity; load calculation; design standards

requirement: IEC/ISO code check uses the load factors specified in IEC 61400-3 (2007) combined with the resistance factors and component strength criteria specified in ISO 19902 (2007)
scope: Structural design and analysis of offshore wind farm components (e.g., monopiles)
related_domains: structural integrity; design standards; offshore wind farm engineering; load calculations

requirement: Safety factors, i.e. 1.5 and 1.25 according to the ABS Guide (2011), are applied respectively to the normal turbine operating mode with the yaw misalignment of 8 degrees and the abnormal turbine operating mode with the yaw misalignment of 30 degrees.
scope: Monopile, tripod, and jacket support structures in the ATL2 and GOM regions, for normal and abnormal turbine operating modes.
related_domains: structural integrity; design standards; operational safety

requirement: A tubular member with diameter D can be considered as hydrodynamically transparent, i.e. diffraction effects can be neglected, when the member diameter does not exceed one fifth of the incident wave length.
scope: Tubular members in offshore structures (e.g., foundations, piles)
related_domains: structural design; hydrodynamics; wave loads; foundation design
